purpose: gnsslad1 (kernel q10jr6 / 0356, ioctl 141): power-on ladder, proven steps 1..0 then NEW step 1 (2 s console pause first): GPS wake vote 0x180601ac[0]=1, poll 0x18060184[5]==0, readback, release (rollback). Readback after every write, Wi-Fi guard before every access. Every step is rolled back at the end (saved original bits restored, vendor off order). Same guest/owned/undo as gnssstep (guest-gnssstep1.sh, owned-gnssstep1.json, payload-gnssstep-undo).
